changes.summary: Animation type aliases renamed: InteractiveAnimate → ElementAnimate, ExpandableAnimate → ContentAnimate, ToggleableAnimate → IndicatorAnimate, OverlayAnimate → LayerAnimate, MenuAnimate → PopupAnimate, MenuItemAnimate → PopupItemAnimate.
changes.details: Old names are still exported as deprecated type aliases. The defaultAnimations object keys also changed: interactive → element, overlay → layer, overlayBackdrop → layerBackdrop, expandable → content, menu → popup, menuItem → popupItem, toggleable → indicator.
changes.migration: Replace imports: InteractiveAnimate → ElementAnimate, ExpandableAnimate → ContentAnimate, ToggleableAnimate → IndicatorAnimate, OverlayAnimate → LayerAnimate, MenuAnimate → PopupAnimate, MenuItemAnimate → PopupItemAnimate. Update defaultAnimations key references accordingly.

changes.summary: All CSS custom properties renamed from --move-input-* to --move-password-*.
changes.details: Password now uses its own namespace: --move-password-bg, --move-password-border, --move-password-border-hover, --move-password-border-focus, --move-password-radius, --move-password-padding-x, --move-password-padding-y, --move-password-font-size, --move-password-fg, --move-password-placeholder, --move-password-height, --move-password-icon-color, --move-password-icon-gap.
changes.migration: If you set --move-input-* tokens specifically to style Password, rename them to --move-password-*. E.g., --move-input-bg becomes --move-password-bg.

changes.summary: SelectItem slots itemIndicator and itemText removed; selected items now use background highlighting.
changes.details: The pt prop for SelectItem no longer accepts itemIndicator or itemText keys. Selected items use [data-selected] attribute with primary background. The data-selected attribute value changed from 'true' to '' (empty string).
changes.migration: Remove any pt={{ itemIndicator: ..., itemText: ... }} from Select.Item. Update CSS selectors from [data-selected='true'] to [data-selected].

changes.summary: Dialog.Content no longer applies padding directly; content must use new Dialog.Header, Dialog.Body, and Dialog.Footer sub-components.
changes.details: The .content CSS no longer has padding or overflow: auto. The .close button is no longer absolutely positioned. New sub-components: Dialog.Header, Dialog.Body, Dialog.Footer, Dialog.FooterStart, Dialog.FooterEnd.
changes.migration: Wrap Dialog content in <Dialog.Header>, <Dialog.Body>, and <Dialog.Footer>. Move <Dialog.Close> inside <Dialog.Header>.

changes.summary: Checkbox wrapper element changed from <div> to <label>, disabled styling uses [data-disabled] attribute.
changes.details: The CSS selector .wrapper:has(.root:disabled) is replaced by .wrapper[data-disabled].
changes.migration: If you targeted .wrapper:has(.root:disabled) in custom CSS, update to .wrapper[data-disabled].

changes.summary: Added size prop ('sm' | 'md' | 'lg') and invalid prop to Checkbox.
Added invalid prop and size prop ('sm' | 'md' | 'lg') to RadioGroup.Root.
Added invalid prop and label prop to Switch.
Added invalid prop to SelectTrigger, animate prop to SelectRoot, width prop to trigger, and label prop to SelectItem.
Added animate prop to Dropdown.Root (PopupAnimate | false).
Added size prop to Dialog.Content ('sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | 'full') and onOpenAutoFocus prop.
Added simple <Tooltip label="..."> wrapper component and animate prop on Tooltip.Content.
changes.details: Tooltip export is now both a simple component and compound component via Object.assign. Entrance animation switched from CSS keyframes to anime.js spring physics.

changes.summary: Added animate prop to Tabs.List, pt and style props to Tabs.Root.
Added showTime prop to DatePicker.Root for integrated time selection.
changes.details: Accepts boolean | { hourCycle?: 12 | 24; placement?: 'inline' | 'popup' }. Default placement is 'inline' (next to date input). Use placement: 'popup' to render inside the calendar popover.

changes.summary: Button CSS refactored to use component-scoped layout tokens (--move-button-gap, --move-button-height, --move-button-padding-x, --move-button-radius, --move-button-font-size, --move-button-font-weight).
Icon now falls back to built-in essential icons when no IconProvider is present.
changes.details: New exports: BUILTIN_ICONS and useResolvedIcon hook. Components like Checkbox, Accordion, and Select can render their icons without requiring an IconProvider.

changes.summary: InputText focus style changed from box-shadow to outline, --move-input-font-size defaults to inherit.
Label --move-label-font-size default changed from var(--move-size-sm) to inherit.
FormField description font-size changed to inherit and added per-control label alignment for horizontal layout.
Accordion trigger icon rotation now synchronizes with content expand/collapse animation. New useAccordion hook exported.
ThemeProvider root div now sets base typography: fontFamily, fontSize, and color from design tokens.
New semantic tokens: --move-scrollbar-thumb, --move-scrollbar-track, --move-overlay-light, --move-overlay-heavy, --move-overlay-blur. Theme tokens refactored to palette variable references.
changes.details: If you created a custom theme, add the new required tokens: --move-scrollbar-thumb and --move-scrollbar-track.
changes.migration: No action needed for default themes. Custom themes must add --move-scrollbar-thumb and --move-scrollbar-track.

changes.summary: New component: Alert for inline feedback messages with variant styling.
New component: Text for body text with size, weight, color, and alignment props.
New component: Heading for semantic heading elements (h1-h6).
New component: Link for styled anchor elements with variant and underline options.
New component: Code for inline code snippets.
New component: Prose for styling long-form HTML/markdown content.
New component: Card with compound sub-components (Root, Header, Title, Description, Body, Footer).
New component: Divider for horizontal/vertical separators.
New component: Collapsible with animated expand/collapse and useCollapsible hook.
New component: ScrollArea with pinned header/footer and scrollable content.
New component: Sidebar with collapsible navigation layout and useSidebar hook.
New component: Splitter for resizable panel layouts.
New component: Popover for floating content anchored to a trigger.
New component: Toast notification system with imperative toast() API.
New component: EmptyState for placeholder content with icon, title, and action slots.
New component: Image with fit, radius, and loading props.
New component: ImageGroup for grid/masonry image layouts.
New component: InputRange (slider) with useInputRange hook.
New component: Textarea with variant and size props matching InputText conventions.
New component: Calendar with single, range, and multiple selection modes and useCalendar hook.
New component: CalendarView for full calendar/schedule display with useCalendarView hook.
New component: DatePicker with compound sub-components, useDatePicker hook, and calendar popup.
New component: TimeField with segment-based time input, optional scroll dropdown, and useTimeField hook.
New component: ToggleGroup for single/multiple selection button groups.
